key_insight: A constrained treasury allocation problem can be reformulated as a QUBO and solved on IBM Quantum hardware with the same optimum as a classical solver for a small proof-of-concept instance.
engineering_relevance: This demonstrates that financially constrained optimization workloads can be mapped to near-term quantum workflows, offering a potential pathway for future treasury and resource-allocation tools.
method: Formulated the Color-of-Money problem as a constrained MILP.
Converted the MILP into a QUBO suitable for quantum execution.
Used a VQA with Pauli Correlation Encoding and error mitigation on IBM Quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: A prototype instance with 3 assets, 3 obligations, and 2 time periods on real IBM hardware reproduced the classical SCIP optimal solution.
watch_item: The demonstration is limited to a small instance, and current noisy hardware still does not show an advantage over classical optimization.
paper_title: Quantum Optimization of the Color-of-Money Problem on IBM Quantum Hardware: A Proof-of-Concept Study
